The forecast shows a stable 30‑day demand of about 54 units per day, so we can plan inventory around that predictable level.  
The recommended order size of 26.9 units balances ordering costs with the 90 % service‑level rule, keeping the overall cost low (≈ $107.5).  
Safety stock of 26.9 units is kept modest because demand variability is low; it protects against unexpected spikes while still fitting the 90 % service target.  
The reorder point of 587 units covers the lead‑time demand plus this safety stock, ensuring we reorder before stock runs out.  
Overall, this plan follows the same logic used for past analyses of SKU S001::P0001, with only a slight adjustment to the order quantity to reflect the current steady demand.
